commands.label: Command Center
commands.description: Run the local dashboard server on port 8788.

commands.label: Pygame Viewer
commands.description: Open the live cinematic chase viewer.

commands.label: Seeded Viewer
commands.description: Open the live viewer with a fixed seed.

commands.label: Headless Viewer Smoke
commands.description: Run the Pygame render loop in dummy video mode for CI-style checks.

commands.label: Record Replay
commands.description: Record a scripted JSONL replay.

commands.label: Play Replay
commands.description: Open a Pygame replay player from a recorded JSONL file.

commands.label: Validate Replay
commands.description: Validate and summarize a replay JSONL file.

commands.label: Replay Report
commands.description: Write a replay-only research report with chase, reward, comms/authentication, checksum, notable-event, and diagnostic evidence.

commands.label: Replay Fidelity Gate
commands.description: Validate a replay, write stable state/radio checksums, and prove same-seed scripted determinism.

commands.label: Physics Acceptance Gate
commands.description: Validate vehicle asymmetry, deterministic stepping, braking stability, collision recovery, and long-run finite-state behavior.

commands.label: MARL Env Gate
commands.description: Validate the PettingZoo parallel API contract, action/observation spaces, finite stepping, determinism, truncation, and counterfactual reward probe.

commands.label: Spectator UI/Audio Gate
commands.description: Validate Pygame headless rendering, web replay cockpit contracts, dashboard replay links, and confidence-driven audio mapping.

commands.label: Operational Readiness Gate
commands.description: Aggregate physics, replay, learned control, information warfare, self-play, dashboard, spectator, and differentiable-comms evidence into one manifest.

commands.label: Research Evidence Bundle
commands.description: Bundle current readiness manifests, active replay reports, replay hashes, dashboard assets, and active checkpoint hashes into one reproducible JSON artifact.

commands.label: Verify Evidence Bundle
commands.description: Re-hash bundle artifacts, revalidate active replays, and confirm replay report scores still match the current files.

commands.label: Scripted Evaluation
commands.description: Evaluate scripted baselines across seeds.

commands.label: Acceptance Scenarios
commands.description: Run replay-backed downtown chase, roadblock, spoof burst, and cipher shift gates.

commands.label: Acceptance Full Targets
commands.description: Run the same scenario suite with the original downtown waypoint target enforced.

commands.label: Evader Checkpoint Acceptance
commands.description: Run downtown acceptance with the learned evader checkpoint against scripted pursuers.

commands.label: Pursuer Team Acceptance
commands.description: Run roadblock acceptance with the learned five-pursuer checkpoint.

commands.label: Active Control Acceptance
commands.description: Run strict full-target acceptance with the active learned evader and pursuer-team pair.

commands.label: Plan Curriculum Repairs
commands.description: Convert an acceptance manifest's diagnostics into prioritized dashboard training commands.

commands.label: Train Evader Imitation
commands.description: Collect scripted evader data, add DAgger correction rollouts, and save the first useful driver checkpoint.

commands.label: Train Evader PPO
commands.description: Train the PPO evader driver with imitation warm start plus live and counterfactual information-warfare reward shaping.

commands.label: Train Pursuer PPO
commands.description: Train one PPO pursuer driver with decoder-accuracy, spoof-susceptibility, and counterfactual deception penalties.

commands.label: Train Pursuer Team PPO
commands.description: Train a shared PPO driver for all five pursuers with live and counterfactual authentication penalties.

commands.label: Train Evader vs Team
commands.description: Train an evader PPO checkpoint against a saved learned pursuer-team opponent.

commands.label: Train Pursuer vs Evader
commands.description: Train one pursuer PPO checkpoint against a saved learned evader opponent.

commands.label: Train Team vs Evader
commands.description: Train a shared five-pursuer PPO checkpoint against a saved learned evader opponent.

commands.label: Train Scanner Decoder
commands.description: Train the evader scanner to translate radio-token history into future pursuer positions.

commands.label: Train Radio Policy
commands.description: Train pursuers to emit six-token English radio messages from observations.

commands.label: Train Jammer Policy
commands.description: Train the evader to trigger spoof bursts, choose payload tokens, and target pursuers.

commands.label: Train Counterfactual Jammer
commands.description: Train the evader jammer from paired jam/no-jam rollouts weighted by actual pursuer deviation.

commands.label: Train/Eval/Promote Stack
commands.description: Train scanner, radio, and heuristic or counterfactual jammer candidates, compare against the active stack, and optionally promote.

commands.label: Run Self-Play Cycle
commands.description: Alternate evader PPO, pursuer-team PPO, faction-specific pool-gated control promotion, and information-stack training.

commands.label: Scenario-Gated Self-Play
commands.description: Run self-play with learned control promotion gated by replay-backed downtown, roadblock, spoof, and cipher scenarios.

commands.label: Control Pair League
commands.description: Score a learned evader and learned five-pursuer team together, optionally writing replay evidence.

commands.label: Control Pool League
commands.description: Score a control candidate against historical evader/team pool opponents before promotion.
commands.default_args: --name candidate_control --evader models/control_active/evader_ppo.pt --pursuer-team models/control_active/pursuer_team_ppo.pt --pool-dir models/control_pool --seeds 11,12 --steps 600 --max-opponents 3 --record-prefix replays/control_league --out logs/control_league_manifest.json

commands.label: List Control Pool
commands.description: Inspect historical evader/pursuer-team checkpoint pairs archived by self-play.

commands.label: Watch Evader Checkpoint
commands.description: Run a saved evader checkpoint against scripted pursuers and optionally record a replay.

commands.label: Record Evader PPO Replay
commands.description: Run a PPO evader checkpoint against scripted pursuers and record a replay.

commands.label: Record Pursuer PPO Replay
commands.description: Run a PPO pursuer checkpoint in the scripted chase and record a replay.

commands.label: Record Pursuer Team Replay
commands.description: Run a learned five-pursuer team checkpoint and record a replay.

commands.label: Record Scanner Replay
commands.description: Run a scanner decoder checkpoint and record replay frames with learned predictions.

commands.label: Record Radio Policy Replay
commands.description: Run learned pursuer radio messages with scripted driving and record a replay.

commands.label: Record Jammer Replay
commands.description: Run learned evader jamming with scripted driving and record spoof events.

commands.label: Record Adversarial Stack
commands.description: Run learned radio, scanner, and jammer together, then write replay and metrics.

commands.label: Authentication Curriculum Eval
commands.description: Run paired jammed/no-spoof episodes and measure counterfactual spoof susceptibility.

commands.label: Checkpoint League Score
commands.description: Aggregate authentication metrics over seeds and optionally promote an active radio/scanner/jammer stack.
commands.default_args: --name candidate --radio checkpoints/radio_policy.pt --scanner checkpoints/scanner_decoder.pt --jammer checkpoints/jammer_policy.pt --seeds 11,12,13 --steps 1200 --record-prefix logs/checkpoint_league --out logs/checkpoint_league_manifest.json

commands.label: V2 Long Checkpoint League
commands.description: Run a longer multi-seed authentication league for research-grade comms/scanner/jamming evidence.
commands.default_args: --name v2_candidate --radio checkpoints/radio_policy.pt --scanner checkpoints/scanner_decoder.pt --jammer checkpoints/jammer_policy.pt --seeds 11,12,13,14,15 --steps 1800 --record-prefix logs/v2_checkpoint_league --out logs/v2_checkpoint_league_manifest.json

commands.label: V2 Research Report
commands.description: Build the JSON and Markdown v2 report from long league, replay, spectator, and evidence artifacts.

commands.label: Live Checkpoint Viewer
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with a learned evader checkpoint controlling the chase.

commands.label: Live Pursuer Checkpoint
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with a learned pursuer checkpoint controlling one police car.

commands.label: Live Pursuer Team
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with a learned five-pursuer checkpoint controlling the police team.

commands.label: Live Scanner Decoder
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with learned scanner predictions and confidence.

commands.label: Live Radio Policy
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with learned pursuer radio tokens.

commands.label: Live Jammer Policy
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with learned evader spoof bursts.

commands.label: Live Adversarial Stack
commands.description: Open the Pygame viewer with learned radio, scanner predictions, and evader spoof bursts.

commands.label: Training Smoke
commands.description: Run the PettingZoo-style training environment with random actions.

commands.label: Unit Test Suite
commands.description: Run all Python unit tests.

commands.label: Compile Check
commands.description: Byte-compile package, scripts, app entrypoint, and tests.
